title: Beyond Fixed Goal Delivery: Online POMDP Planning for Target Interception in Crowds
description:
arXiv:2607.18517v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Target interception in crowded environments requires reaching a moving objective while navigating among multiple uncertain human agents. Since human navigation intent is not directly observable, the robot must reason over multiple possible future interaction outcomes.
